title: EEG: Probabilistic Selection Task (PST) + PST with Cabergoline Challenge
description: EEG recordings from a Probabilistic Selection Task (PST) collected in two studies: 80 healthy participants plus 5 pilot placebo sessions, and a double-blind cabergoline (1.25 mg) challenge study with 27 completers. Data were collected circa 2012-2013 at Brown University and share a sample with a previously published study on conflict as an implicit cost in reinforcement learning. The dataset supports research on reinforcement learning, dopamine, and feedback processing.
methods_description: The PST was programmed in Matlab and EEG was recorded while participants performed the task. Study 2 used a double-blind, two-session design in which participants received either cabergoline (1.25 mg) or placebo in each session. Data were collected in the Laboratory for Neural Computation & Cognition at Brown.
